result.summary: Wrote lib/letflow/design/req073-identity-user-routes.md. Route wiring: POST/GET /users, GET/PATCH /users/:id, POST /users/:id/status under Letflow.Routers.Identity (mounted at /identity). Every handler composes scoped_repo_opts/1 (step 1) then Authorization.evaluate_access/2 against :UsersManage (step 2, before any Repo call -- structural AC4 guarantee) then Letflow.Api.Validation (create/patch/status bodies) then a named Letflow.Identity function, responses via an explicit 8-key user_map/1 allowlist (id/username/display_name/email/status/auth_source/inserted_at/updated_at -- password_hash/external_id/external_realm excluded per INV-2). Found Letflow.Identity has ZERO general user-CRUD functions today (only OIDC/realm plumbing) -- named 5 new thin functions to add (create_user/2, list_users/2, get_user/2, update_user_profile/3, update_user_status/3) plus one small addition to the already-shipped Letflow.Api.Authorization.endpoint_policy_key/2 (no existing clause for POST /users/:id/status). Cross-tenant-404 test design reuses REQ-072's exact scoped_repo_opts/1 mechanism and context_test.exs's byte-identical-body assertion pattern, now dispatched through the real Letflow.Routers.Identity.call/2 handler. Permission-denial test design asserts full-row-unchanged (not just count) for patch/status-update, and row-count-unchanged for create. Tenant-isolation list test seeds two tenants with an identical username to prove per-schema uniqueness AND per-schema list scoping simultaneously. Chose direct Letflow.Routers.Identity.call/2 dispatch (auth_context assigned directly on the conn, bypassing AuthPipeline) for every test in this design, since neither existing OIDC test double (TokenVerifierDouble/ConfigurableTokenVerifierDouble) can mint a token claiming PLATFORM_ADMIN -- both are hardcoded to a fixed 'VIEWER' roles claim, which Authorization.roles_from_strings/1 doesn't even recognize. This follows established precedent (router_test.exs's REQ-070 AC2, context_test.exs) rather than inventing a new mechanism; recorded as OQ-6, not blocking.

issues.description: OQ-1..OQ-6 in the design doc: cursor tiebreak field choice (OQ-1), inserted_at/updated_at JSON shape convention (OQ-2), placeholder password_hash value for internally-created users (OQ-3), exact search-field scope for list_users/2 not checked against R-Co's identity_service.listUsers -- out of this requirement's named source-file scope (OQ-4), whether update_user_status/3 shares profile_changeset/2 (OQ-5), and whether TEST-DESIGNER should also extend ConfigurableTokenVerifierDouble for a fuller real-auth end-to-end path in addition to direct sub-router dispatch (OQ-6). None block implementation; all are explicit, not silently resolved.

Letflow.Api.Authorization.endpoint_policy_key/2 (an already-'done', REQ-069-owned module) needs one additive new clause for ("POST", "/users/:id/status") -> :UsersManage. Flagged since it crosses into a different requirement's already-shipped module, even though the change is small and additive.
